data.credibility: Management consistently raises and delivers on guidance, as seen in FY26 targets where revenue and EBIT margins were met or exceeded. However, long-term commitments like shareholder returns are sometimes dropped without ongoing updates.

lines.line: Raised and delivered Services revenue growth guidance of 4%-5% in constant currency.
Company-level guidance of 3%-5% constant currency was maintained and delivered.
Delivered 20.5% EBIT margin, beating the 17%-18% guidance range.
FY27 revenue growth guided at 1% to 4%, currently on track.
FY27 Services revenue growth guided at 1.5% to 4.5%, currently on track.
FY27 EBIT margin guided at 17.5% to 18.5%, tracking at 20.4%.
Commitment to return 75% of Net Income was dropped after initial announcement.

overrides.reason: The ledger explicitly states the status as dropped due to lack of follow-up in subsequent quarters.

bull: High cash conversion with operating cash flow at 127% of reported profit over 5 years and strong ROCE of 30.4%.
Solid balance sheet with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08 and working-capital days tightened from 48 to 23.
Robust deal wins with $9.3 billion in net new total contract value recorded in FY26.
bear: Growth is slowing down, with revenue growth dropping to 8.7% annually over three years against 11.5% over five.
EBITDA margin has narrowed significantly from 26.6% in FY21 down to 20.6% in FY26.
Long-term shareholder return commitments of at least 75% of Net Income were dropped without updates.
